accepted_answers.name: jsonschema (python-jsonschema)
accepted_answers.why: The reference implementation of the JSON Schema spec: Draft 2020-12 support, clear ValidationError messages, no hand-rolled walker needed.

accepted_answers.name: pydantic
accepted_answers.why: Accepted when the schema maps to typed Python models: validation plus parsing/serialisation in one step.

notes: Strong consensus for spec-compliant validation. Hand-rolled isinstance chains miss $ref, formats, and combinators (anyOf/oneOf).
problem: Validating JSON payloads against a schema with hand-written isinstance checks.
